# Project Phoenix v49.0 All-12-Era Ruler & Dynasty Portrait Overhaul.
# Generated by tools/gen_v490_era_ruler_portraits.py; edit the generator, not this file.
# Additional portrait models/textures: Bamboo King's Community Flavor Pack (Workshop 3763953914),
# used with permission (2026-11-20); see third_party/bamboo_king/MANIFEST_V49.md.
# Character scope (portrait modifiers at priority = 102, selection_behavior = max).
# Uses ONLY vanilla country tags + culture / graphical culture / rank / government / year triggers so Main Mod
# passes strict standalone audits and seamlessly governs all 12 eras (361-1821).

# Yield unfallen 1337 Yuan court & secretariats entirely to oe_yp_clothes / oe_yp_headwear (priority = 101).
oe_v49_is_unfallen_yuan_court = {
	oe_yp_yuan_fallen = no
	OR = {
		oe_yp_portrait_any = yes
		employer ?= { tag = CHI }
		portrait_is_ruler_of_trigger = { COUNTRY = CHI }
	}
}

# Base eligibility guard: secular adult males not currently leading a field army, not clergy/theocracy/military order,
# and not opted out via the vanilla portrait mode global variable.
oe_v49_portrait_eligible_male = {
	exists = this
	is_adult = yes
	is_female = no
	is_religious_figure = no
	NOT = { has_estate = estate_type:clergy_estate }
	NOT = { portrait_clergy_trigger = { RELIGION_GFX = buddhist_gfx } }
	NOT = { is_general = yes }
	NOT = { is_mercenary_leader = yes }
	NOT = { any_ruling_countries = { government_type = government_type:theocracy } }
	NOT = { any_ruling_countries = { has_reform = government_reform:military_order_reform } }
	NOT = { any_ruling_countries = { country_type = army } }
	NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_v49_portraits_vanilla_mode }
	NOT = { oe_v49_is_unfallen_yuan_court = yes }
}

# Cultural family helpers (has_culture_group strictly inside culture ?= { ... }).
oe_v49_is_jurchen_manchu = {
	OR = {
		gfx_culture_applicable = tungusic_coa_gfx
		culture ?= {
			OR = {
				has_culture_group = culture_group:jurchen_group
				has_culture_group = culture_group:tungusic_group
			}
		}
	}
}

oe_v49_is_mongol = {
	OR = {
		gfx_culture_applicable = mongol_gfx
		culture ?= { has_culture_group = culture_group:mongolian_group }
	}
}

oe_v49_is_japanese = {
	OR = {
		gfx_culture_applicable = japanese_gfx
		culture ?= { has_culture_group = culture_group:japanese_group }
	}
}

oe_v49_is_chinese_group = {
	culture ?= { has_culture_group = culture_group:chinese_group }
}

oe_v49_is_sinospheric_non_steppe = {
	NOT = { oe_v49_is_jurchen_manchu = yes }
	NOT = { oe_v49_is_mongol = yes }
	NOT = { oe_v49_is_japanese = yes }
	OR = {
		oe_v49_is_chinese_group = yes
		any_ruling_countries = {
			OR = {
				tag = KOR
				tag = DAI
				tag = MNG
				tag = CSH
				tag = CSO
			}
		}
		employer ?= {
			OR = {
				tag = KOR
				tag = DAI
				tag = MNG
				tag = CSH
				tag = CSO
			}
		}
	}
}

# --- EAST ASIAN DYNASTIC HIERARCHY ---

# 1. Ming / Post-1368 Han Chinese Emperor -> Imperial Dragon Yuanlingpao + Winged Crown (翼善冠)
oe_v49_chinese_ming_emperor = {
	oe_v49_portrait_eligible_male = yes
	NOT = { oe_v49_is_jurchen_manchu = yes }
	NOT = { oe_v49_is_mongol = yes }
	NOT = { oe_v49_is_japanese = yes }
	OR = {
		portrait_is_ruler_of_trigger = { COUNTRY = MNG }
		AND = {
			current_year >= 1368
			oe_v49_is_chinese_group = yes
			any_ruling_countries = {
				country_rank_level = 4
				government_type = government_type:monarchy
			}
		}
	}
}

# 2. Tang / Song Emperor (600-1367) -> Imperial Dragon Yuanlingpao + Flared Futou (展脚幞头)
oe_v49_chinese_tang_song_emperor = {
	oe_v49_portrait_eligible_male = yes
	NOT = { oe_v49_is_jurchen_manchu = yes }
	NOT = { oe_v49_is_mongol = yes }
	NOT = { oe_v49_is_japanese = yes }
	current_year >= 600
	current_year < 1368
	OR = {
		portrait_is_ruler_of_trigger = { COUNTRY = CSH }
		portrait_is_ruler_of_trigger = { COUNTRY = CSO }
		AND = {
			oe_v49_is_chinese_group = yes
			any_ruling_countries = {
				country_rank_level = 4
				government_type = government_type:monarchy
			}
		}
	}
}

# 3. Classical Pre-600 Chinese Emperor (361-599) -> Vanilla Dragon Mian Robe + 12-Tassel Mianguan (十二旒冕冠)
oe_v49_chinese_classical_emperor = {
	oe_v49_portrait_eligible_male = yes
	NOT = { oe_v49_is_jurchen_manchu = yes }
	NOT = { oe_v49_is_mongol = yes }
	NOT = { oe_v49_is_japanese = yes }
	current_year < 600
	oe_v49_is_chinese_group = yes
	any_ruling_countries = {
		country_rank_level = 4
		government_type = government_type:monarchy
	}
}

# 4. Jurchen / Manchu / Qing Rulers & Cabinet (1204 Jin, 1648/1776/1821 Qing)
oe_v49_jurchen_high = {
	oe_v49_portrait_eligible_male = yes
	oe_v49_is_jurchen_manchu = yes
	OR = {
		any_ruling_countries = { country_rank_level >= 2 }
		in_cabinet = yes
		is_heir = yes
	}
}

oe_v49_jurchen_low = {
	oe_v49_portrait_eligible_male = yes
	oe_v49_is_jurchen_manchu = yes
	NOT = { oe_v49_jurchen_high = yes }
}

# 5. Japanese Shogun / Emperor / High Daimyo & Lower Noble Courtiers
oe_v49_japanese_high = {
	oe_v49_portrait_eligible_male = yes
	oe_v49_is_japanese = yes
	OR = {
		portrait_is_ruler_of_trigger = { COUNTRY = JAP }
		portrait_is_ruler_of_trigger = { COUNTRY = YMT }
		any_ruling_countries = { country_rank_level >= 2 }
		in_cabinet = yes
	}
}

oe_v49_japanese_low = {
	oe_v49_portrait_eligible_male = yes
	oe_v49_is_japanese = yes
	NOT = { oe_v49_japanese_high = yes }
	NOT = { has_estate = estate_type:peasants_estate }
	NOT = { has_estate = estate_type:tribes_estate }
}

# 6. Chinese / Korean / Vietnamese Kings & Princes (Rank 3 Monarchy)

		country_rank_level = 3

	}
}

	oe_v49_chinese_king = yes

}

# --- GLOBAL EARLY-MODERN & IMPERIAL ANTI-DOWNGRADE STABILIZER ---

# 8. 1640+ European Early-Modern Monarchy Rulers (preserves Byzantine/Roman east_mediterranean_gfx & roman_gfx!)
oe_v49_euro_late_emperor = {
	oe_v49_portrait_eligible_male = yes
	current_year >= 1640
	gfx_culture_applicable = european_gfx
	NOT = { gfx_culture_applicable = east_mediterranean_gfx }
	NOT = { gfx_culture_applicable = roman_gfx }
	NOT = { portrait_religion_clothing_trigger = { RELIGION_FLAG = muslim_gfx } }
	any_ruling_countries = {
		government_type = government_type:monarchy
		OR = {
			country_rank_level = 4
			AND = {
				exists = international_organization:hre
				is_leader_of_international_organization = international_organization:hre
			}
		}
	}
}

oe_v49_euro_late_king = {
	oe_v49_portrait_eligible_male = yes
	current_year >= 1640
	gfx_culture_applicable = european_gfx
	NOT = { gfx_culture_applicable = east_mediterranean_gfx }
	NOT = { gfx_culture_applicable = roman_gfx }
	NOT = { portrait_religion_clothing_trigger = { RELIGION_FLAG = muslim_gfx } }
	NOT = { oe_v49_euro_late_emperor = yes }
	any_ruling_countries = {
		government_type = government_type:monarchy
		country_rank_level = 3
	}
}
